newsitem.title: USA: American Healthcorp to spin off AmSurg.
newsitem.headline: American Healthcorp to spin off AmSurg.

text.p: American Healthcorp Inc., which provides diabetes management services, said Tuesday it has filed plans to spin off its 59 percent owned AmSurg Corp. unit to American Healthcorp stockholders.

"The distribution will enable American Healthcorp and AmSurg to finance the expansion of their businesses more effectively and should better position the two companies to provide greater value to stockholders," the company said.
The spinoff is subject to an Internal Revenue Service ruling that the deal is substantially tax-free to shareholders, the Nashville, Tenn.-based company said.
American Healthcorp stockholders are expected to be subject to federal income tax with respect to 1.5 percent of the shares of AmSurg received, it said.
AmSurg will begin trading as a separate public company on Nasdaq on the date that the shares are distributed.

American Healthcorp's subsidiary, Diabetes Treatment Centres of America, Inc., provides comprehensive diabetes management services to managed care organisations and others. It is also the nation's largest operator of hospital-based diabetes treatment and arthritis and osteoporosis treatment centres.
American Healthcorp's stock rose 87.5 cents to $13.875 on Nasdaq.
